reason: No auto-charge means I'd actually start the 14-day trial, since that's what I always do. But on day 14 I'd drop back to the free version. My AirPods already cut the sound when I fall asleep, and I'm not paying monthly for something I mostly have already.
objection: Getting back to sleep at 3am is my real problem, and the resume button is nice, but it's still me pressing a button half-awake. The automatic version needs an armband I'd have to buy, and that's 2028. So what am I paying for right now that's better than free?
would_change_my_mind: If my own day-14 record showed I got back to sleep after waking at 3-4am clearly faster, like 15+ minutes, I'd probably pay the 4,900 won for a month to see if it holds up.
